_readme: FILL THIS IN, THEN REPLACE EVERY {{TOKEN}} IN THE SITE WITH ITS VALUE. Apply across all .html files + site.js + sitemap.xml + robots.txt. Values below are EXAMPLES for a fictional plumbing shop — overwrite them all.

identity.KEYWORDS: plumbing, emergency plumber, drain cleaning, water heater repair, pipe repair

branding._note: Pack default accent. Overridden per prospect by the logo-derived brandColors.primary (RAW_JSON on agencyProspect); null primary keeps this default.

address._note: LAT/LNG must come from the client's Google Business Profile pin — right-click the pin in Google Maps.

service_area._note: NEARBY_1 through NEARBY_5 each have a dedicated city landing page. NEARBY_6-10 only appear in the areaServed schema.

proof._note: RATING and REVIEW_COUNT must match the client's real Google numbers.

hero.HERO_LEDE: Serving Springfield and surrounding communities with expert residential and commercial plumbing since 1998. Fast response, honest pricing, guaranteed workmanship.

services.SERVICE_1_DESC: Complete plumbing solutions for your home — repairs, installations, and maintenance.
services.SERVICE_2_DESC: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and flooding — we respond within the hour.
services.SERVICE_3_DESC: Professional drain cleaning using advanced hydro-jetting technology.
services.SERVICE_4_DESC: Tankless and traditional water heater repair, replacement, and installation.
services.SERVICE_5_DESC: Advanced leak detection and repair for residential and commercial properties.
services.SERVICE_6_DESC: Complete plumbing services for offices, restaurants, and retail spaces.
services._note: These 6 drive the nav dropdown, home grid and footer. The 6 service-*.html PAGES still contain the old vertical's titles, H1s, FAQ schema and body copy — those are NOT tokenized.

reviews.REVIEW_1_TEXT: Called at 11pm for a burst pipe. They arrived within 30 minutes and had everything fixed by midnight. Professional, clean, and fair pricing. Would definitely call again!
reviews.REVIEW_2_TEXT: We've been using them for our restaurant for 5 years. Always on time, always professional. The team knows commercial plumbing inside and out.
reviews.REVIEW_3_TEXT: Replaced our old water heater with a tankless system. The installation was smooth, they explained everything, and the energy savings are already showing on our bills.
reviews._note: NEVER invent reviews. These feed Review + AggregateRating JSON-LD. Pull the client's real Google reviews verbatim.

integrations._note: DISCONNECTED BY DEFAULT — form runs in demo mode. To go live: GoHighLevel -> Automation -> Workflows -> Create -> Trigger 'Inbound Webhook' -> copy URL.
